messages:
Maria (PM): quick async Q3 OKR milestone check-in for eng + product. keeping this short — what shipped, what slipped, owners, and next steps. react with :eyes: if you’ve read and drop blockers below.

Maria (PM): SHIPPED: 
- model catalog v2 rollout ✅ (doc + sdk hooks) — owner: Jon
- cost-visibility per-route (console) ✅ — owner: Priya

Maria (PM): SLIPPED / RISKS: 
- autoscaler policy for Dedicated (canary) slipped one week due to OOM incidents in staging — owner: Adam 
- KV-prefix cache consistency fix for long-context sessions slipped (blocked by infra mem regression) — owner: Sanjeev

Maria (PM): IN PROGRESS / NEXT STEPS: 
- Jon: gradual traffic shift to v2 catalog; monitor latency by model. target: 2025-08-05. dependency: autoscaler stability.
- Adam: finalize autoscaler policy + add emergency buffer -> rollout plan by 2025-08-01. need SRE signoff.
- Sanjeev + Ellie: KV cache fix PR + perf tests. if PR green, schedule canary on dedicated next Tue.

Jon (Eng): Confirmed catalog v2 rollout finished last night. perf baseline looks good except tail latency on long sequences (>2048). tagging @Ellie for ML perf. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Ellie (Eng-ML): saw the tail too. probable KV cache warm-up effect post-quantization. I have a short repro and a small fix, pushing PR now. ETA: EOD.

Sanjeev (Infra): KV cache mem spike came from a combination of batch window change + stale eviction logic. PR is up but blocked by failing CI tests (integration env flakiness). Need Adam's help reproducing the OOM locally.

Adam (SRE): I scaled the dedicated pool temporarily to avoid customer impact and attached the log bundle to the incident ticket. quick command I used: `kubectl scale --replicas=8 deploy/redwood-runtime -n dedicated-prod`
I can reproduce OOM on my laptop with the stress client — will add reproducer steps in the ticket.

Sanjeev (Infra): thanks — will look at the logs you attached. if we can get a reproducer, I can iterate faster.

Priya (Design): console copy for per-route cost is live on staging. will ship to prod after we confirm autoscaler won't spike costs during rollout.

Maria (PM): ownership notes: Jon (catalog), Adam (autoscaler), Sanjeev (cache infra), Ellie (ML perf), Priya (console copy). please update your sprint cards; if you need help re-prioritizing OKR scope ping me.

Jon (Eng): quick ask — can someone ping @Ellie and approve my PR #482 for model-metadata change? it's small but gating the canary.

Ellie (Eng-ML): on it. reviewing now.

deploy-bot: automated note — nightly canary scheduled for 2025-08-02 02:00 UTC (will hold until autoscaler policy patch is merged).

Maria (PM): thanks all. final asks: 1) Adam — post reproducer + ETA in the incident ticket by EOD today; 2) Sanjeev/ Ellie — aim to merge KV fix PR tomorrow morning; 3) Jon/ Priya — hold broader traffic shift until autoscaler patch is in prod.

Adam (SRE): ack. posting reproducer in ticket in ~2h. :thumbsup:

Ellie (Eng-ML): ack. targeting morning merge.

Sanjeev (Infra): ack — will prioritize CI flakiness to unblock.

Maria (PM): great. I'll summarize this for the weekly sync doc and mark the OKR line-items accordingly. if anything changes, update the thread. thanks! :party_popper:
